items.title: Gartner (IT) Stock Still Looks Cheap On A 54% Three Year Slide

items.title: Gartner (IT) Maps Out 2027 AI Trends That Could Shape Enterprise Tech Budgets
items.summary: Gartner (NYSE:IT) released its top strategic technology trends for 2027, focusing on emerging AI and digital architectures. The firm highlighted large quantitative models aimed at regulated sectors such as financial services, healthcare, and government. Gartner also pointed to advanced speech reasoning models and AI context platforms as key technologies it expects enterprises to assess. items.title: Barclays downgrades Gartner, flags AI risks for information services stocks
items.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays downgraded Gartner (NYSE: IT) to Underweight while raising its price target to $185 from $150 in a note on Friday, as the bank remains cautious on information services companies whose business models could be disrupted by AI.
